cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Build a Coalition
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to your side so your position appears broader and more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Will you join my request to keep the pottery room open late? It looks like a personal favour with one name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Your name would show it's bigger than the evening class.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The morning class wants weekend access.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Add that. Could you bring two of them? We'd be several classes asking for better access.

mechanism: A authorizes additional access demands to recruit several classes behind a request originally serving personal evening use.
confusable: A simple petition signature would resemble D52; D55 needs expansion across groups to make the position broader and more legitimate.
comparison: Pottery classes combine late and weekend access, unlike the allotment scene one shared-key concession gathering new holders.
seedUse: Use D55-b daytime nonbeneficiary and morning weekend interest, with S01 approval controlling the expanded platform and recruitment.
